 Shelling in Donetsk region kills 2 people and injures 3 in a day – regional military administration
 Wednesday, 28 October 2026, 10:33 
 The region recorded 24 Russian shelling attacks in a day. 
 Two people were killed in shelling attacks on settlements in Donetsk region, and 3 more were wounded. Donetsk regional military administration head Vadym Filashkin reported this on Wednesday.
 This is reported by Інтерфакс-Україна .
 2 people were wounded in Sloviansk, Kramatorsk district. There, apartment buildings, cafés, shops, a church, a private house and industrial premises were damaged.
